'''Xaban''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] who served in [[Havoc Squad]], an elite unit in the [[Republic Special Forces Division]] of the [[Republic Army]].<ref name="TOR" /> Around [[3630 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|4.2}}</ref> the unit's leader, [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Aric Jorgan]], took the squad on an unsanctioned mission to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Zakuul]], where they waged a guerrilla war against the [[Eternal Empire]] that had [[Eternal Empire conquest|conquered]] [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Xaban was added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''{{'s}} Digital Expansion [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire|''Knights of the Fallen Empire'']] as part of Chapter XI: Disavowed,<ref name="TOR" /> which was released on [[March 10]], [[2016]].<ref name="Web">{{TORweb|url=info/news/press-release/20160218|text=BioWare Announces Disavowed &mdash; Coming March 10, 2016}}</ref> Xaban was originally named Xabar, but was changed before the chapter's final release.
